name: Madeleine Valois
source:
Madeleine is the youngest daughter of a noble family residing in Ocendawyr. Being the youngest, her parents have the tendency to neglect her, her older sister being of higher priority since she is the one who will eventually inherit the family name.

When Oscar's father decided to appoint Madeleine as Oscar's valette, she accepted his offer, knowing that by staying with her family there is nothing much to be gained.
